property_mix.era: mixed Victorian terraces and extensive post-war social housing
property_mix.notable: significant post-1960s new town expansion; large proportion of public housing stock requiring bulk lock maintenance and rekeying services

locksmith_relevant: Runcorn's rapid 1960s–80s expansion created many council estates with standardised locks; bulk master-key systems remain common across housing associations.
Victorian and Edwardian terraces in older quarters demand period-appropriate rim locks and mortice repairs; listed-building compliance adds specialisation need.
High density of rental HMOs and multi-occupancy flats (student lets, shared housing) drive frequent lock changes and access-control retrofits.

sources.overpass: OSM places inside ONS BUA 2022 boundary for Runcorn, 19 named areas
